items.titleZh: 类风湿关节炎中RNA甲基化的代谢控制：从滑膜应激到致病性细胞适应
items.abstractZh: 类风湿关节炎（RA）是一种慢性自身免疫性疾病，其特征为持续性滑膜炎、侵袭性血管翳形成、软骨降解和骨侵蚀。尽管代谢重编程和表观遗传失调日益被认为是类风湿关节炎的核心特征，但局部代谢应激转化为持久致病性细胞状态的机制仍不完全清楚。表观转录组学的最新进展表明，动态RNA修饰，特别是RNA甲基化，作为免疫和基质细胞适应的关键转录后调控因子发挥作用。局部缺氧、糖酵解通量增强、乳酸积累、线粒体功能障碍、氧化应激和脂质代谢失衡共同影响RNA甲基化调控因子的表达、活性、底物可用性和转录选择性。这些代谢条件化的RNA修饰程序，包括经典的N6-甲基腺苷（m6A）和新出现的非m6A标记如内部N7-甲基鸟苷（m7G），可能有助于在多种细胞类型中稳定致病表型。在成纤维样滑膜细胞（FLS）中，RNA甲基化维持糖酵解适应性、侵袭行为以及对凋亡和铁死亡的抵抗。在巨噬细胞中，它增强炎症极化和细胞外囊泡介导的通讯。在T细胞和中性粒细胞中，它促进Th17极化、自噬缺陷、氧化应激反应和过度中性粒细胞胞外陷阱（NET）形成。我们进一步讨论了RNA甲基化如何整合非编码RNA网络、细胞外囊泡信号和调节性细胞死亡途径以维持慢性滑膜炎症和组织破坏。最后，我们强调了这种代谢-表观转录组界面的转化意义，包括生物标志物发现、患者分层和微环境知情治疗策略。靶向代谢应激和RNA甲基化依赖性适应可能为类风湿关节炎的精准导向干预提供新机会。

items.title: Inflammatory marker profiles vary by BMI across Crohn's disease, ulcerative colitis, psoriasis, and psoriatic arthritis.
items.abstract: Obesity represents a state of chronic low-grade inflammation, yet comprehensive comparative analyses examining systemic inflammatory markers across multiple immune-mediated inflammatory diseases (IMIDs) in relation to body mass index (BMI) categories remain limited. We evaluated how obesity-associated inflammatory burden manifests longitudinally across immunologically distinct conditions. We conducted a longitudinal cohort study using de-identified electronic health record data from the Optum Labs Data Warehouse, selecting adult patients with Crohn's disease (CD), ulcerative colitis (UC), psoriasis (PsO), or psoriatic arthritis (PsA) with at least two BMI measurements over five years. Using generalized mixed effects regression models, we estimated associations between BMI categories (healthy weight, <25 kg/m²; overweight, 25.0-29.9 kg/m²; obesity, ≥30 kg/m²) and C-reactive protein (CRP), erythrocyte sedimentation rate (ESR), and ferritin. We compared patients with obesity and patients with overweight plus a high-risk comorbidity to the healthy-weight referent. Across all four conditions, patients with obesity demonstrated significantly elevated CRP (49-83% higher) and ESR (24-48% higher) at baseline compared to healthy-weight counterparts. Patients with overweight plus high-risk comorbidities showed intermediate elevations (CRP 34-55% higher, ESR 13-30% higher). These patterns attenuated over time but remained statistically significant through year 5 in nearly all cohorts. Ferritin demonstrated near null associations across all conditions. Consistent CRP and ESR elevations across four immunologically distinct IMIDs, combined with null ferritin associations, suggest that excess adiposity may contribute to systemic inflammatory burden regardless of underlying disease mechanism, warranting further investigation of weight optimization as part of comprehensive IMID management.

items.titleZh: 炎症标志物谱在不同BMI下克罗恩病、溃疡性结肠炎、银屑病和银屑病关节炎中有所差异
items.abstractZh: 肥胖代表一种慢性低度炎症状态，然而，跨多种免疫介导的炎症性疾病（IMIDs）中，系统炎症标志物与体重指数（BMI）类别关系的全面比较分析仍然有限。我们评估了肥胖相关炎症负担如何在免疫学上不同的疾病中纵向表现。我们使用Optum Labs数据仓库中去除身份标识的电子健康记录数据进行了一项纵向队列研究，选取了患有克罗恩病（CD）、溃疡性结肠炎（UC）、银屑病（PsO）或银屑病关节炎（PsA）且在五年内至少两次BMI测量的成年患者。使用广义混合效应回归模型，我们估计了BMI类别（健康体重，<25 kg/m²；超重，25.0-29.9 kg/m²；肥胖，≥30 kg/m²）与C反应蛋白（CRP）、红细胞沉降率（ESR）和铁蛋白之间的关联。我们将肥胖患者以及超重且伴有高风险合并症的患者与健康体重参照组进行比较。在所有四种疾病中，与健康体重对应者相比，肥胖患者在基线时表现出显著升高的CRP（高出49-83%）和ESR（高出24-48%）。超重且伴有高风险合并症的患者显示出中间水平的升高（CRP高出34-55%，ESR高出13-30%）。这些模式随时间减弱，但在几乎所有队列中至第5年仍具有统计学显著性。铁蛋白在所有疾病中均显示接近零的关联。在四种免疫学上不同的IMIDs中一致的CRP和ESR升高，结合铁蛋白关联为零，提示过多的脂肪组织可能无论潜在疾病机制如何都促进系统性炎症负担，这值得进一步研究体重优化作为IMID综合管理的一部分。

items.title: A Hospitalized Patient With Systemic Scleroderma Requiring ICU-Level Care.
items.abstract: A patient with a history of systemic scleroderma complicated by interstitial lung disease on two liters of home oxygen at baseline presented to the emergency department with a two-week history of progressively worsening dysphagia. An initial chest X-ray showed concerns for bilateral pneumonia and aspiration. Initial laboratory results revealed anemia with a hemoglobin level of 6.9 g/dL. After receiving intravenous antibiotics and beginning transfusion of one unit of packed red blood cells, the patient went from being weak on examination to becoming lethargic, hypoxic, hypercapnic, hypertensive, and hypothermic due to flash pulmonary edema in the setting of a hypertensive emergency. Within only a few hours of being in the emergency department, the patient required transfer to the medical ICU; a prolonged hospital course ensued, eventually leading to a stable discharge, nearly three months later.

items.title: Livedoid Vasculopathy Mimicking Rheumatoid Vasculitis in a Patient With Active Rheumatoid Arthritis.
items.abstract: Livedoid vasculopathy (LV) is a rare thrombo-occlusive disorder of the dermal microcirculation that may clinically resemble inflammatory vasculitis. In patients with rheumatoid arthritis (RA), the development of painful lower extremity ulcers often raises concern for rheumatoid vasculitis, making histopathological evaluation essential for accurate diagnosis and treatment selection. We present a case of a 45-year-old man with an eight-year history of seropositive RA receiving methotrexate, sulfasalazine, and baricitinib who developed painful lower extremity ulcers, edema, and episcleritis in the setting of high disease activity (Disease Activity Score 28 using C-reactive protein {DAS28-CRP} of 6.23). Given the suspicion of rheumatoid vasculitis, an extensive diagnostic workup was performed. Laboratory studies demonstrated elevated inflammatory markers and negative antineutrophil cytoplasmic antibodies. Skin biopsy revealed vascular wall hyalinization, luminal obliteration, and fibrin thrombi in the absence of inflammatory infiltrates or fibrinoid necrosis, establishing the diagnosis of livedoid vasculopathy. Treatment with systemic glucocorticoids and rituximab, administered according to the standard rheumatoid arthritis regimen, resulted in partial improvement in ocular inflammation, joint symptoms, and cutaneous ulceration. Anticoagulant therapy was not initiated because treatment escalation was primarily directed toward uncontrolled rheumatoid arthritis and severe extra-articular manifestations. Histopathological examination demonstrated vascular wall hyalinization, luminal obliteration, and fibrin thrombi in the absence of significant vascular inflammation or fibrinoid necrosis, establishing the diagnosis of livedoid vasculopathy and excluding rheumatoid vasculitis. Although initial clinical improvement was observed, recurrent ocular symptoms and persistent lower extremity ulceration developed following interruption of biologic therapy. Histopathological confirmation demonstrating thrombotic microvascular occlusion without vascular inflammation was essential for establishing the diagnosis and avoiding misclassification as rheumatoid vasculitis. This case highlights the importance of tissue diagnosis in patients with RA presenting with ulcerative cutaneous lesions and emphasizes the need to consider livedoid vasculopathy in the differential diagnosis of suspected rheumatoid vasculitis.

items.titleZh: 活动性类风湿关节炎患者中模拟类风湿血管炎的网状青斑样血管病
items.abstractZh: 网状青斑样血管病（LV）是一种罕见的真皮微循环血栓闭塞性疾病，临床上可能类似炎症性血管炎。在类风湿关节炎（RA）患者中，出现疼痛性下肢溃疡常引起对类风湿血管炎的担忧，使得组织病理学评估对于准确诊断和治疗选择至关重要。我们报告一例45岁男性患者，有8年血清阳性RA病史，接受甲氨蝶呤、柳氮磺吡啶和巴瑞替尼治疗，在高疾病活动度（使用C反应蛋白的28关节疾病活动度评分{DAS28-CRP}为6.23）背景下出现疼痛性下肢溃疡、水肿和巩膜外层炎。鉴于怀疑类风湿血管炎，进行了广泛的诊断检查。实验室研究显示炎症标志物升高，抗中性粒细胞胞浆抗体阴性。皮肤活检显示血管壁透明样变、管腔闭塞和纤维蛋白血栓，无炎症浸润或纤维素样坏死，从而确立网状青斑样血管病的诊断。根据标准类风湿关节炎方案给予全身性糖皮质激素和利妥昔单抗治疗，眼部炎症、关节症状和皮肤溃疡部分改善。未启动抗凝治疗，因为治疗升级主要针对未控制的类风湿关节炎和严重的关节外表现。组织病理学检查显示血管壁透明样变、管腔闭塞和纤维蛋白血栓，无明显血管炎症或纤维素样坏死，确立网状青斑样血管病的诊断并排除类风湿血管炎。尽管观察到初步临床改善，但在中断生物治疗后出现复发性眼部症状和持续性下肢溃疡。组织病理学证实血栓性微血管闭塞而无血管炎症，对于确立诊断和避免误分类为类风湿血管炎至关重要。本病例强调了在表现为溃疡性皮肤病变的RA患者中进行组织诊断的重要性，并强调在疑似类风湿血管炎的鉴别诊断中需考虑网状青斑样血管病。

items.title: Beyond the Kidneys: Multisystem Systemic Lupus Erythematosus Presenting With Cardiac Tamponade, Class V Lupus Nephritis, Dysphagia, and Peripheral Neurologic Manifestations.
items.abstract: Systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) is a chronic autoimmune disorder characterized by immune dysregulation, immune complex deposition, and multisystem inflammation with highly variable clinical manifestations. Although lupus nephritis and serositis are common complications, the simultaneous occurrence of biopsy-proven membranous lupus nephritis, cardiac tamponade, polyserositis, dysphagia, and peripheral neurologic manifestations is uncommon and presents significant diagnostic and therapeutic challenges. We present the case of a 37-year-old Hispanic woman with newly diagnosed SLE who developed progressive dysphagia, peripheral sensory deficits, pleural and pericardial involvement complicated by cardiac tamponade, ascites, and biopsy-proven International Society of Nephrology/Renal Pathology Society (ISN/RPS) Class V lupus nephritis. Laboratory evaluation demonstrated a homogeneous antinuclear antibody titer greater than 1:2560, elevated anti-double-stranded DNA antibodies, hypocomplementemia, and approximately 2 g/day of proteinuria. Cross-sectional imaging demonstrated extensive serosal involvement, including bilateral pleural effusions, a large pericardial effusion, pelvic ascites, and perihepatic free fluid. Renal biopsy demonstrated ISN/RPS Class V membranous lupus nephritis with subepithelial, intramembranous, and mesangial immune-type electron-dense deposits and near-global podocyte foot process effacement on electron microscopy. The patient required urgent pericardiocentesis and multidisciplinary management with pulse corticosteroids, hydroxychloroquine, mycophenolate mofetil, and belimumab. Following treatment, her clinical condition improved with resolution of cardiac tamponade and stabilization of her multisystem disease. This case highlights the protean nature of SLE and emphasizes the importance of recognizing simultaneous renal, cardiac, neurologic, gastrointestinal, and serosal involvement. Early multidisciplinary evaluation and prompt immunosuppressive therapy are essential to preventing irreversible organ damage and improving clinical outcomes.

items.titleZh: 超越肾脏：以心脏压塞、V型狼疮性肾炎、吞咽困难和周围神经表现为特征的多系统系统性红斑狼疮。
items.abstractZh: 系统性红斑狼疮（SLE）是一种慢性自身免疫性疾病，其特征为免疫失调、免疫复合物沉积和多系统炎症，临床表现高度可变。尽管狼疮性肾炎和浆膜炎是常见并发症，但经活检证实的膜性狼疮性肾炎、心脏压塞、多浆膜炎、吞咽困难和周围神经表现同时出现并不常见，且带来显著的诊断和治疗挑战。我们报告一例37岁西班牙裔女性新诊断SLE的病例，患者出现进行性吞咽困难、周围感觉缺陷、胸膜和心包受累并发心脏压塞、腹水，以及经活检证实的国际肾脏病学会/肾脏病理学会（ISN/RPS）V型狼疮性肾炎。实验室评估显示均质型抗核抗体滴度大于1:2560，抗双链DNA抗体升高，低补体血症，以及约2克/天的蛋白尿。横断面影像显示广泛浆膜受累，包括双侧胸腔积液、大量心包积液、盆腔腹水和肝周游离液体。肾活检显示ISN/RPS V型膜性狼疮性肾炎，电镜下可见上皮下、膜内和系膜区免疫型电子致密物沉积，以及近乎全部的足细胞足突融合。患者需要紧急心包穿刺术和多学科管理，包括脉冲糖皮质激素、羟氯喹、吗替麦考酚酯和贝利尤单抗。治疗后，患者临床状况改善，心脏压塞缓解，多系统疾病稳定。本病例凸显了SLE的多变性，并强调识别同时存在的肾脏、心脏、神经、胃肠道和浆膜受累的重要性。早期多学科评估和及时免疫抑制治疗对于预防不可逆器官损伤和改善临床结局至关重要。

items.title: Changes in serious infection and mortality among patients with ANCA-associated vasculitis during the COVID-19 pandemic: an interrupted time-series analysis of J-CANVAS.
items.abstract: In antineutrophil cytoplasmic antibody (ANCA)-associated vasculitis, infection risk exceeds that of the general population, and infection is a leading cause of death. However, the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on serious infections and mortality in this population remains uncertain. This observational study used data from the nationwide registry in Japan (Japan Collaborative Registry of ANCA-Associated Vasculitis), which includes patients with newly diagnosed and relapsed ANCA-associated vasculitis from 29 sites between January 2017 and March 2023. The primary outcome was serious infection requiring hospitalisation; the secondary outcome was all-cause mortality. The impact of COVID-19 was estimated using an interrupted time-series analysis, with the boundary between April and May 2020 as the change point, following the first declaration of a state of emergency in Japan. Monthly incidence rates were modelled using segmented Poisson regression. Rate ratios (RRs) for level and slope changes with 95% CI were reported. Several sensitivity analyses were performed. Among 1064 patients, total follow-up was 37,535 person-months; 205 serious infections and 96 deaths occurred. For serious infection, the level-change RR was 0.54 (95% CI: 0.31-0.94) and the slope-change RR was 1.01 (0.98-1.04). For all-cause mortality, the level-change RR was 0.35 (0.12-0.98) and the slope-change RR was 1.001 (0.94-1.06). Findings were robust across sensitivity analyses. Immediately after the onset of the COVID-19 pandemic, a clear reduction in serious infections and mortality was observed without major changes in patient characteristics. These findings may reflect the impact of social and personal infection control measures.

items.title: Efficacy and safety of venanprubart, a BTLA agonist antibody, in patients with active systemic lupus erythematosus.
items.abstract: This phase 2 study's objective was to determine whether venanprubart is superior to placebo for inducing remission of rash and/or arthritis in patients with at least moderately active systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE). Patients (N = 85) were randomly assigned in a 1:1 ratio to venanprubart (N = 42) or placebo (N = 43) in a multinational, multicentre, randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled, parallel-group, 2-arm, phase 2 clinical trial. Treatment (450 mg venanprubart or placebo) was administered subcutaneously every 2 weeks along with standard of care for 24 weeks. The primary endpoint was remission of rash and/or arthritis as defined by the Systemic Lupus Erythematosus Disease Activity Index (SLEDAI) 2000 at week (W) 24. Patients who discontinued the study or violated concomitant medication rules were imputed to nonresponse. The study was terminated early based on lack of efficacy at the interim analysis. Venanprubart did not separate from placebo in inducing remission of rash and/or arthritis in 54 patients (26 on venanprubart; 28 on placebo) with SLE at W24. Patients treated with venanprubart were not significantly different from placebo for SLEDAI-4 response or Systemic Lupus Erythematosus Responder Index-4 response through W24. The number of treatment-emergent adverse events was similar across treatment groups. Patients treated with venanprubart reported 4 (9.5%) serious adverse events, whereas patients treated with placebo reported 1 (2.3%). No deaths occurred during the study. B and T lymphocyte attenuator receptor occupancy approached saturation on B cells, CD4+ T cells, and CD8+ T cells at all postrandomisation time points. Venanprubart did not demonstrate superiority to placebo in achieving remission of rash and/or arthritis. Venanprubart was safe and well tolerated.

items.titleZh: Venanprubart（一种BTLA激动剂抗体）在活动性系统性红斑狼疮患者中的疗效和安全性
items.abstractZh: 这项2期研究的目的是确定venanprubart在至少中度活动性系统性红斑狼疮（SLE）患者中诱导皮疹和/或关节炎缓解方面是否优于安慰剂。在一项跨国、多中心、随机、双盲、安慰剂对照、平行组、双臂、2期临床试验中，患者（N = 85）按1：1比例随机分配至venanprubart组（N = 42）或安慰剂组（N = 43）。治疗（450 mg venanprubart或安慰剂）每2周皮下注射一次，同时接受标准治疗，持续24周。主要终点是第24周时根据系统性红斑狼疮疾病活动指数（SLEDAI）2000定义的皮疹和/或关节炎缓解。中止研究或违反合并用药规则的患者被计为无应答。由于中期分析显示缺乏疗效，研究提前终止。在第24周时，venanprubart在诱导54名SLE患者（venanprubart组26名；安慰剂组28名）的皮疹和/或关节炎缓解方面未与安慰剂区分开。接受venanprubart治疗的患者在第24周时的SLEDAI-4应答或系统性红斑狼疮应答者指数-4应答与安慰剂组相比无显著差异。治疗中出现的不良事件数量在各治疗组间相似。接受venanprubart治疗的患者报告了4例（9.5%）严重不良事件，而接受安慰剂治疗的患者报告了1例（2.3%）。研究期间无死亡发生。在所有随机化后时间点，B和T淋巴细胞衰减因子受体占用率在B细胞、CD4+ T细胞和CD8+ T细胞上接近饱和。Venanprubart在实现皮疹和/或关节炎缓解方面未显示出优于安慰剂的疗效。Venanprubart安全且耐受性良好。

items.title: Cardiac involvement in immune-mediated necrotizing myopathy: a case report with insights from cardiac magnetic resonance imaging.
items.abstract: Immune-mediated necrotising myopathy (IMNM) is a rare autoimmune disease recently recognised as part of the spectrum of idiopathic inflammatory myopathies. Although cardiac involvement is a prominent extramuscular manifestation in anti-signal recognition particle (SRP) IMNM, there remains a lack of sufficient cardiac magnetic resonance imaging data. Here, we present a case of anti-SRP IMNM with cardiac involvement as the initial symptom, utilising imaging assessments at various stages of the disease to evaluate and monitor disease progression and treatment response. These findings may provide valuable insights for the clinical identification and management of anti-SRP IMNM with cardiac involvement.

items.titleZh: 免疫介导坏死性肌病的心脏受累：一例心脏磁共振成像的病例报告
items.abstractZh: 免疫介导坏死性肌病（IMNM）是一种罕见的自身免疫性疾病，最近被认为是特发性炎症性肌病谱系的一部分。尽管心脏受累是抗信号识别颗粒（SRP）IMNM中突出的肌外表现，但仍缺乏足够的心脏磁共振成像数据。在此，我们报告一例以心脏受累为首发症状的抗SRP IMNM病例，利用疾病各阶段的影像学评估来评估和监测疾病进展及治疗反应。这些发现可能为抗SRP IMNM伴心脏受累的临床识别和管理提供有价值的见解。

items.title: Assessing the real-world impact of interstitial lung disease in patients with rheumatoid arthritis on healthcare resources and treatment patterns through natural language processing.
items.abstract: Interstitial lung disease (ILD) is a serious pulmonary complication and a major cause of morbidity and mortality in several connective tissue diseases, notably rheumatoid arthritis (RA). We developed a study to compare the healthcare resource utilisation in patients with RAILD and RA-non-ILD and establish the impact of ILD diagnosis in the treatment of patients with RA using natural language processing (NLP) of electronic health records (EHRs). This observational, retrospective, multicentre study analysed unstructured clinical data from EHRs of patients with RA with and without ILD (RAILD and RA-non-ILD) from 9 hospitals in Spain, spanning January 2014 to December 2019. NLP was used to extract and standardise data into Systematized Nomenclature of Medicine - Clinical Terms (SNOMED-CT) terminology. The study aimed to compare healthcare resource utilisation and treatment patterns between the 2 groups, focusing on changes in treatment following ILD diagnosis in patients with RAILD. Among 13,958 patients with RA, 712 (5.1%) were identified as having RA-ILD, with 433 diagnosed during the study period. Patients with RAILD had significantly higher healthcare resource utilisation than patients with RA-non-ILD, particularly in pneumology (60.5% vs 9.0%), internal medicine (37.4% vs 19.9%), and emergency departments (57.3% vs 39.1%). Hospitalisation rates were also higher in patients with RAILD (64.5% vs 31.9%). Prior to ILD diagnosis, tumour necrosis factor inhibitors were the most commonly prescribed treatments, whereas after diagnosis, drugs with different mechanisms, such as rituximab and abatacept, were more frequently initiated. The development of ILD in patients with RA is associated with increased healthcare resource utilisation and different treatment patterns. NLP on EHRs is a valuable tool for offering insights into disease management and healthcare burden in patients with RAILD.

items.titleZh: 通过自然语言处理评估类风湿关节炎患者间质性肺病对医疗资源和治疗模式的真实世界影响
items.abstractZh: 间质性肺病（ILD）是一种严重的肺部并发症，也是多种结缔组织病（尤其是类风湿关节炎（RA））发病和死亡的主要原因。我们开展了一项研究，通过电子健康记录（EHRs）的自然语言处理（NLP），比较RAILD和RA-non-ILD患者的医疗资源利用情况，并确定ILD诊断对RA患者治疗的影响。这项观察性、回顾性、多中心研究分析了来自西班牙9家医院2014年1月至2019年12月期间有或无ILD的RA患者（RAILD和RA-non-ILD）EHRs中的非结构化临床数据。NLP用于将数据提取并标准化为医学系统命名法-临床术语（SNOMED-CT）术语。该研究旨在比较两组之间的医疗资源利用和治疗模式，重点关注RAILD患者ILD诊断后的治疗变化。在13,958名RA患者中，712名（5.1%）被确定为患有RA-ILD，其中433名在研究期间被诊断。RAILD患者的医疗资源利用显著高于RA-non-ILD患者，尤其是在肺病科（60.5%对9.0%）、内科（37.4%对19.9%）和急诊科（57.3%对39.1%）。RAILD患者的住院率也更高（64.5%对31.9%）。在ILD诊断前，肿瘤坏死因子抑制剂是最常用的处方治疗，而诊断后，具有不同机制的药物（如利妥昔单抗和阿巴西普）更常被启用。RA患者发生ILD与医疗资源利用增加和不同的治疗模式相关。EHRs上的NLP是一种有价值的工具，可为RAILD患者的疾病管理和医疗负担提供见解。

items.title: Understanding patient-reported disease burden in systemic sclerosis: key clinical and demographic features revealed by the EULAR Systemic Sclerosis Impact of Disease (ScleroID) Questionnaire.
items.abstract: Systemic Sclerosis Impact of Disease (ScleroID) is a validated patient-reported outcome measure that assesses disease burden in systemic sclerosis (SSc). In this study, we aim to identify clinical and demographic features associated with disease burden reported by ScleroID. We investigated a multicentric SSc cohort with a cross-sectional and a longitudinal arm. We compared differences in ScleroID between demographic and clinical subgroups, and correlations with disease activity (patient-reported global assessment [PtGA] and physician-reported global assessment [PhGA]). Spearman correlation, Wilcoxon rank sum, Kruskal-Wallis, linear, and logistic regression were applied. We included 471 patients (median age 57 years, 37% diffuse cutaneous SSc). In the adjusted multivariable model, work disability, lower educational level, a longer disease duration, severe dyspnoea, and oesophageal symptoms remained independently associated with higher patient-reported burden (corresponding to higher ScleroID scores). The ScleroID score strongly correlated with PtGA (ρ = 0.78, P < .001) and less with the PhGA. Preliminary findings indicate that clinical disease progression at 1 year was associated with a significantly larger change in the ScleroID score ( P = .03) from baseline to follow-up. We identified demographic, clinical, and socioeconomic features associated with a high disease burden in SSc: longer disease duration, work disability and lower education status, severe dyspnoea, and oesophageal symptoms. Several health dimensions of ScleroID were affected simultaneously, highlighting the need for a holistic approach. ScleroID and objective clinical outcomes are complementary in identifying patient subgroups with a relevant disease burden and progression.

items.titleZh: 理解系统性硬化症患者报告疾病负担：EULAR系统性硬化症疾病影响（ScleroID）问卷揭示的关键临床和人口学特征
items.abstractZh: 系统性硬化症疾病影响（ScleroID）是一种经过验证的患者报告结局指标，用于评估系统性硬化症（SSc）的疾病负担。在本研究中，我们旨在识别与ScleroID报告疾病负担相关的临床和人口学特征。我们调查了一个多中心SSc队列，包括横断面和纵向两部分。我们比较了不同人口学和临床亚组之间ScleroID的差异，以及其与疾病活动度（患者报告总体评估[PtGA]和医生报告总体评估[PhGA]）的相关性。应用了Spearman相关、Wilcoxon秩和检验、Kruskal-Wallis检验、线性和逻辑回归。我们纳入了471名患者（中位年龄57岁，37%为弥漫性皮肤SSc）。在调整后的多变量模型中，工作残疾、较低教育水平、较长病程、严重呼吸困难和食管症状仍与较高的患者报告负担（对应较高的ScleroID评分）独立相关。ScleroID评分与PtGA强相关（ρ = 0.78，P < .001），与PhGA相关性较弱。初步发现表明，1年时临床疾病进展与ScleroID评分从基线到随访的显著较大变化相关（P = .03）。我们确定了与SSc高疾病负担相关的人口学、临床和社会经济特征：较长病程、工作残疾和较低教育水平、严重呼吸困难和食管症状。ScleroID的多个健康维度同时受到影响，强调需要整体方法。ScleroID和客观临床结局在识别具有相关疾病负担和进展的患者亚组方面具有互补性。

items.title: In search of a window of opportunity in axial spondyloarthritis: treatment outcomes across different symptom durations.
items.abstract: This study aimed to determine the effectiveness of a first tumour necrosis factor inhibitor (TNFi) in patients with short and long symptom duration in axial spondyloarthritis (axSpA), using alternative cut-offs for back pain duration: ≤1 year as very early, >1 year, and ≤5 years as intermediate axSpA, and >5 years as late axSpA. A total of 1161 patients with axSpA from the Swiss Clinical Quality Management registry, who had data on the duration of back pain and initiated their first TNFi, were included. Patients were categorised as follows: very early axSpA ( N = 138), intermediate axSpA ( N = 329), and late axSpA ( N = 694). Adjusted logistic regression models were used to compare the likelihood of achieving a low disease activity status (Axial Spondyloarthritis Disease Activity Score [ASDAS] <2.1) at 1 year, adjusting for age, sex, human leucocyte antigen-B27, educational level, body mass index, ASDAS, current smoking, and presence of inflammation on magnetic resonance imaging of the sacroiliac joints. Drug survival was analysed using multiple-adjusted Cox proportional hazards models. Missing data were addressed through multiple imputation by chained equations. Higher disease activity parameters were found at baseline in very early axSpA. However, no significant differences were observed in treatment response or TNFi retention between very early and late axSpA (odds ratio for ASDAS < 2.1 response 0.99, 95% CI: 0.62-1.59 and hazard ratio for drug discontinuation 1.09, 95% CI: 0.87-1.37). Based on this real-world observational data, no evidence was found to suggest a superior effectiveness of TNFi in patients with very early axSpA compared with those with late axSpA.

items.titleZh: 寻找中轴型脊柱关节炎的治疗窗口：不同症状持续时间下的治疗结局。
items.abstractZh: 本研究旨在评估中轴型脊柱关节炎（axSpA）患者中，首次使用肿瘤坏死因子抑制剂（TNFi）在不同症状持续时间下的有效性，采用背部疼痛持续时间的不同截点：≤1年为极早期，>1年且≤5年为中期axSpA，>5年为晚期axSpA。研究纳入了来自瑞士临床质量管理登记处的1161例axSpA患者，这些患者有背部疼痛持续时间数据并首次启动TNFi治疗。患者被分为：极早期axSpA（N=138）、中期axSpA（N=329）和晚期axSpA（N=694）。使用校正后的逻辑回归模型比较1年时达到低疾病活动状态（中轴型脊柱关节炎疾病活动评分[ASDAS] <2.1）的可能性，校正因素包括年龄、性别、人类白细胞抗原-B27、教育水平、体重指数、ASDAS、当前吸烟状况以及骶髂关节磁共振成像中的炎症存在情况。药物存留率采用多重校正的Cox比例风险模型进行分析。缺失数据通过链式方程多重插补处理。极早期axSpA患者基线时疾病活动参数较高。然而，极早期与晚期axSpA之间在治疗反应或TNFi存留率方面未观察到显著差异（ASDAS < 2.1反应的比值比为0.99，95% CI：0.62-1.59；药物停用的风险比为1.09，95% CI：0.87-1.37）。基于这项真实世界观察性数据，未发现证据表明极早期axSpA患者使用TNFi的有效性优于晚期axSpA患者。

items.title: Risk of nonmelanoma skin cancer in patients with psoriatic arthritis and according to bDMARD treatment-a cohort study from the Nordic Arthritis Research Collaboration.
items.abstract: To investigate if psoriatic arthritis (PsA) itself and if biological disease-modifying antirheumatic drugs (bDMARDs) used in PsA are associated with increased risks of nonmelanoma skin cancer (NMSC). From nationwide health and clinical rheumatology registers in 4 Nordic countries, we identified patients with PsA who between 2010 and 2021 started a: (i) tumour necrosis factor inhibitor (TNFi), or (ii) non-TNFi bDMARD, or were (iii) b/targeted synthetic (ts)DMARD naïve. For Sweden and Denmark, we identified incident patients with PsA (2010-2021) and corresponding general population (GP) comparator subjects. Using ever-treated follow-up, incidence rates and adjusted hazards ratios (aHRs) with 95% CIs were calculated for NMSC overall, basal cell carcinoma (BCC), and squamous cell carcinoma (SCC), respectively. We identified 619 NMSCs among incident patients with PsA (n = 23,553). We observed 221 NMSCs in TNFi-treated (n = 9999), 34 NMSCs in non-TNFi bDMARD-treated (n = 2200), and 433 NMSCs in b/tsDMARD-naïve (n = 19,089) PsA. The aHR of NMSC for incident PsA vs GP was 1.20 (1.11-1.31). Pooled aHRs for NMSC overall were 1.24 (1.03-1.50) with TNFi and 1.11 (0.75-1.63) with non-TNFi bDMARDs vs b/tsDMARD-naïve PsA. Corresponding aHRs of BCC were 1.21 (0.93-1.58) for TNFi and 0.85 (0.42-1.69) for non-TNFi bDMARDs, whereas aHRs for SCC were 1.46 (0.84-2.56) and 2.37 (0.95-5.90). Increased risks of NMSC (SCC in particular) were found in patients with PsA compared with the GP. Compared with b/tsDMARD-naïve PsA, TNFi was associated with an increased risk of NMSC overall, whereas a nonsignificantly increased risk of SCC was seen for non-TNFi bDMARDs. However, causality between bDMARD use and NMSC in PsA remains uncertain.

items.titleZh: 银屑病关节炎患者非黑色素瘤皮肤癌风险及根据bDMARD治疗情况——来自北欧关节炎研究协作组的队列研究。
items.abstractZh: 旨在调查银屑病关节炎（PsA）本身以及用于PsA的生物疾病修饰抗风湿药（bDMARDs）是否与非黑色素瘤皮肤癌（NMSC）风险增加相关。从4个北欧国家的全国健康与临床风湿病学登记处，我们识别了2010年至2021年间开始使用（i）肿瘤坏死因子抑制剂（TNFi）、（ii）非TNFi bDMARD，或（iii）b/靶向合成（ts）DMARD初治的PsA患者。对于瑞典和丹麦，我们识别了偶发PsA患者（2010-2021年）及相应的普通人群（GP）对照受试者。使用曾治疗随访，计算了NMSC总体、基底细胞癌（BCC）和鳞状细胞癌（SCC）的发病率及调整后风险比（aHRs）及其95%置信区间。我们在偶发PsA患者（n=23,553）中识别出619例NMSC。在TNFi治疗者（n=9999）中观察到221例NMSC，非TNFi bDMARD治疗者（n=2200）中34例，b/tsDMARD初治PsA（n=19,089）中433例。偶发PsA与GP相比，NMSC的aHR为1.20（1.11-1.31）。与b/tsDMARD初治PsA相比，TNFi和非TNFi bDMARD的NMSC总体合并aHR分别为1.24（1.03-1.50）和1.11（0.75-1.63）。相应的BCC aHR为TNFi 1.21（0.93-1.58）和非TNFi bDMARD 0.85（0.42-1.69），而SCC的aHR分别为1.46（0.84-2.56）和2.37（0.95-5.90）。与GP相比，PsA患者中观察到NMSC（尤其是SCC）风险增加。与b/tsDMARD初治PsA相比，TNFi与NMSC总体风险增加相关，而非TNFi bDMARD观察到SCC风险非显著增加。然而，bDMARD使用与PsA中NMSC之间的因果关系仍不确定。

items.title: Prevalence, outcomes, and predictive factors: a systematic literature review to inform the development of EULAR Points to Consider for the definition of Difficult-to-Manage and Treatment-Refractory psoriatic arthritis.
items.abstract: To perform a systematic literature review (SLR) to inform the EULAR Task Force "Points to Consider for the definitions of Difficult-to-Manage (D2M) and Treatment-Refractory (TR) psoriatic arthritis (PsA)". The SLR addressed 3 separate questions concerning the following: (1) prevalence, (2) outcomes, and (3) predictors of D2M/TR PsA. A search was conducted in MEDLINE (Ovid), Cochrane Database of Systematic Reviews, CENTRAL, EMBASE, and Epistemonikos from inception to March 3, 2024, as well as EULAR/ACR abstracts for 2023/24 and 2022/23, respectively. This systematic review adhered to Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses guidelines and was registered on PROSPERO. Data are summarised descriptively. Meta-analysis was not possible due to significant heterogeneity and/or lack of high-quality evidence. Risk of bias (RoB) was assessed using the Newcastle-Ottawa Scale. Overall, 70, 4, and 25 articles/abstracts were included for questions 1, 2, and 3, respectively. For question 1, 30/70 records had low/moderate RoB, with the prevalence of D2T PsA ranging from 5% to 80% depending on both the timepoint at which prevalence was measured and the definition of D2M/TR PsA applied, which varied significantly between studies. For question 2, all records had a high RoB; therefore, no conclusions could be drawn. For question 3, all records had a moderate RoB, and 84 categories of potential predictors were identified, with large differences in strength and direction of association between studies. Despite significant heterogeneity in the published literature regarding the scope, definition, long-term outcomes, and predictors of D2M/TR PsA, certain patterns emerged that helped shape the final EULAR Task Force recommendations.

items.titleZh: 患病率、结局和预测因素：一项系统文献综述，为制定EULAR关于难以管理和难治性银屑病关节炎定义的重点考虑提供信息。
items.abstractZh: 进行一项系统文献综述（SLR），为EULAR工作组“关于难以管理（D2M）和难治性（TR）银屑病关节炎（PsA）定义的重点考虑”提供信息。该SLR针对三个独立问题：（1）患病率，（2）结局，以及（3）D2M/TR PsA的预测因素。检索了MEDLINE（Ovid）、Cochrane系统评价数据库、CENTRAL、EMBASE和Epistemonikos，时间从建库至2024年3月3日，以及2023/24和2022/23年的EULAR/ACR摘要。本系统评价遵循系统评价和荟萃分析首选报告项目指南，并在PROSPERO注册。数据以描述性方式总结。由于显著的异质性和/或缺乏高质量证据，无法进行荟萃分析。使用纽卡斯尔-渥太华量表评估偏倚风险（RoB）。总体而言，问题1、2和3分别纳入了70、4和25篇文章/摘要。对于问题1，30/70条记录具有低/中度偏倚风险，D2T PsA的患病率范围为5%至80%，具体取决于测量患病率的时间点以及所应用的D2M/TR PsA定义，各研究间差异显著。对于问题2，所有记录均具有高偏倚风险；因此，无法得出任何结论。对于问题3，所有记录均具有中度偏倚风险，并确定了84类潜在预测因素，各研究间关联的强度和方向存在较大差异。尽管已发表文献在D2M/TR PsA的范围、定义、长期结局和预测因素方面存在显著异质性，但出现了一些模式，有助于形成最终的EULAR工作组建议。

items.title: Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) collaborative care involving acupuncture for axial spondyloarthritis: 6-week exploratory results of a pragmatic randomised controlled trial.
items.abstract: This pragmatic randomised controlled trial aimed to assess the clinical effectiveness and safety of a Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) collaborative model of care (TCMCMC) in patients with active axial spondyloarthritis (axSpA). Here, we present the week 6 analysis. Patients with active axSpA (Bath Ankylosing Spondylitis Disease Activity Index [BASDAI] ≥4), spinal pain ≥4 and inadequate response to nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs were randomised to receive either usual rheumatologic care (control) or TCMCMC (intervention, ie, usual rheumatologic care with TCM consultations and 10 acupuncture sessions). Spinal pain at week 6 was the primary outcome. Evaluation of other clinical and quality of life outcomes at week 6 was exploratory. We recruited 139 participants, with 69 and 70 in the control and intervention groups, respectively. Median (IQR) age was 42.0 (33.0-56.0) years and 98 (70.5%) participants were male. Spinal pain and BASDAI scores were 0.75 (95% CI: -1.46, -0.03) and 0.71 (95% CI: -1.30, -0.13) points lower in the intervention than the control group (below the minimal clinically important differences of 1.5-1.6 and 1.3-1.4, respectively). Adjustments for baseline scores did not significantly alter the results. Ankylosing Spondylitis Quality of Life scores were 1.21 (95% CI: -2.30, -0.11) points lower in the intervention after adjusting for baseline scores. 36-item Short Form Health Survey Mental Component Summary was 4.30 (95% CI: -8.03, -0.56) lower in the intervention when unadjusted, but insignificant after adjusting for baseline. Other outcomes were not statistically significant. One adverse event was observed in each group. The intervention group had improved spinal pain, disease activity, and disease-specific quality of life, without significant safety risks.

items.titleZh: 中医协作护理模式（含针灸）治疗中轴型脊柱关节炎：一项实用性随机对照试验的6周探索性结果
items.abstractZh: 这项实用性随机对照试验旨在评估中医协作护理模式（TCMCMC）对活动性中轴型脊柱关节炎（axSpA）患者的临床有效性和安全性。本文报告第6周的分析结果。活动性axSpA患者（巴斯强直性脊柱炎疾病活动指数[BASDAI]≥4）、脊柱疼痛≥4且对非甾体抗炎药反应不足的患者被随机分配接受常规风湿病护理（对照组）或TCMCMC（干预组，即常规风湿病护理加中医咨询和10次针灸治疗）。第6周脊柱疼痛是主要结局。第6周其他临床和生活质量结局的评估为探索性。我们招募了139名参与者，对照组和干预组分别为69名和70名。中位（IQR）年龄为42.0（33.0-56.0）岁，98名（70.5%）参与者为男性。干预组的脊柱疼痛和BASDAI评分分别比对照组低0.75（95% CI：-1.46，-0.03）和0.71（95% CI：-1.30，-0.13）分（低于最小临床重要差异1.5-1.6和1.3-1.4）。对基线评分的调整未显著改变结果。调整基线评分后，干预组的强直性脊柱炎生活质量评分低1.21（95% CI：-2.30，-0.11）分。未调整时，干预组的36项简短健康调查心理成分总结低4.30（95% CI：-8.03，-0.56）分，但调整基线后无显著差异。其他结局无统计学显著性。每组各观察到一例不良事件。干预组的脊柱疼痛、疾病活动度和疾病特异性生活质量得到改善，且无显著安全风险。

items.title: Real-world disease burden, patient journey and treatment patterns in eosinophilic granulomatosis with polyangiitis in Europe and the USA.
items.abstract: An enhanced understanding of eosinophilic granulomatosis with polyangiitis (EGPA) in clinical practice may help identify areas where patient management could be improved. The objectives of this study were to examine the real-world demographics, patient diagnostic journey, disease burden, treatment patterns, and health-related quality of life (HRQoL) of patients with EGPA. Data were drawn from the Adelphi Real World EGPA Disease Specific Programme, a cross-sectional survey of patients with EGPA and their physicians in Europe (France, Germany, Italy, Spain, and the UK) and the USA from July to December 2023. The study included 121 physicians and 503 patients. Most patients were White (89%), the mean (SD) age was 49.5 (15.3) years, and the distribution of sexes was balanced. Mean (SD) time between sign/symptom onset and EGPA diagnosis was 9.8 (19.1) months. Patients had a mean (SD) of 5.5 (3.8) signs and/or symptoms at diagnosis, and physician-perceived severity of EGPA was mild in 20%, moderate in 55%, and severe in 24% of patients. Glucocorticoids were the most prescribed therapies (79%), and the use of interleukin-5-/receptor alpha-targeted therapies was low (21% mepolizumab, 7% benralizumab, <1% reslizumab). Patient-reported HRQoL and work productivity were most impacted in those with organ damage, oral glucocorticoid dose ≥10 mg/day, blood eosinophil count ≥300 cells/μL, or relapse, refractory, deteriorating, moderate, or severe disease. EGPA is associated with a considerable disease burden. Increased disease awareness to facilitate prompt diagnosis and treatment and optimised management to achieve remission and enhance patients' HRQoL are needed.

items.title: Epidemiology and mortality of dermatomyositis and polymyositis in Oklahoma 2010-2023.
items.abstract: Dermatomyositis (DM) and polymyositis (PM) are autoimmune diseases characterised by muscle inflammation, presenting significant challenges in clinical management. Both diseases share common features, such as muscle involvement, but differ in clinical manifestations. This study aims to compare the epidemiologic characteristics and mortality rates of DM and PM among a population of Oklahoma patients. Utilising data from the Clinical Research Data Warehouse (CRDW) at the University of Oklahoma Health Sciences Center (OUHSC), a retrospective cohort study was conducted to examine demographic patterns, prevalence, and mortality outcomes. A total of 321 patients diagnosed with DM or PM between 2010 and 2023 were included, with demographic factors such as age, race, sex, and living premises evaluated. Logistic regression models identified significant associations between DM and women, although PM was more prevalent in African American individuals. Age at diagnosis was significantly associated with mortality. Although there were more deaths among individuals classified as DM, the difference in mortality was not significantly different between those with DM and those with PM. The findings highlighted the importance of demographic factors in disease presentation and outcomes, underscoring the need for targeted healthcare strategies and further research into inflammatory myopathies.

items.titleZh: 2010-2023年俄克拉荷马州皮肌炎和多发性肌炎的流行病学及死亡率
items.abstractZh: 皮肌炎（DM）和多发性肌炎（PM）是以肌肉炎症为特征的自身免疫性疾病，在临床管理中面临重大挑战。这两种疾病具有共同特征，如肌肉受累，但在临床表现上有所不同。本研究旨在比较俄克拉荷马州患者人群中DM和PM的流行病学特征及死亡率。利用俄克拉荷马大学健康科学中心（OUHSC）临床研究数据仓库（CRDW）的数据，进行了一项回顾性队列研究，以检查人口统计学模式、患病率和死亡结局。共纳入2010年至2023年间诊断为DM或PM的321名患者，评估了年龄、种族、性别和居住地等人口统计学因素。Logistic回归模型确定了DM与女性之间的显著关联，而PM在非裔美国人个体中更为普遍。诊断年龄与死亡率显著相关。尽管被归类为DM的个体死亡人数更多，但DM与PM之间的死亡率差异无统计学显著性。研究结果强调了人口统计学因素在疾病表现和结局中的重要性，凸显了针对炎症性肌病制定针对性医疗策略和进一步研究的必要性。

items.title: Similar negative effects of fatigue on physical activity in persons with rheumatoid arthritis and healthy controls: results of a cross-sectional patient-control study.
items.abstract: The objective of this study was to investigate objectively measured physical activity (PA) patterns and the association between PA and self-reported fatigue in persons with rheumatoid arthritis (pwRA), as compared with healthy controls (HCs). In this cross-sectional study, 23 pwRA (Disease Activity Score 28 > 2.6, 52 ± 13 years, 20 females) and 18 HCs (52 ± 10 years, 14 females) wore an ActiGraph wGT3X-BT tri-axial accelerometer (ActiGraph LLC) on 1 ankle for at least 4 days. Accelerometer-based outcomes were vector magnitude counts/min (VM CPM ), step count, and the amount of time that PA was performed at moderate-to-vigorous intensity (MVPA). Accelerometer data were categorised by day (weekday vs weekend) and time of the day (daytime vs evening) to investigate PA patterns. Physical and cognitive fatigue were assessed with questionnaires (Fatigue Severity Scale and Modified Fatigue Impact Scale). Associations between fatigue, presence of RA, and PA were examined using multilevel generalised estimating equations models, with patient and day-timing as levels. Interactions between the presence of RA and fatigue were tested. The VM CPM , step count, and MVPA were lower in pwRA than in HC across various daytime periods (overall: 1233.4 ± 509.4 cpm/h in pwRA vs 1701.2 ± 492.8 in HC, 586.9 ± 225.8 vs 723.8 ± 224.1 steps/h, and 1.6 ± 1.4 vs 2.7 ± 1.5 min/h, respectively). Multivariably, lower VM CPM was seen in pwRA (β = -330.63; 95% CI = -650.45 to -10.81), with higher fatigue (β = -43.89; 95% CI = -135.26 to 47.48), and with higher body mass index (β = -27.18; 95% C I = -50.73 to -3.62). The effect of fatigue or daytime on PA was not modified by the presence of RA. Persons with RA performed less PA than HC. Fatigue had a similarly negative effect on PA in pwRA and HC.

items.titleZh: 疲劳对类风湿关节炎患者和健康对照者体力活动的相似负面影响：一项横断面患者-对照研究结果
items.abstractZh: 本研究旨在客观测量类风湿关节炎患者（pwRA）与健康对照者（HCs）的体力活动（PA）模式，并探讨PA与自我报告疲劳之间的关联。在这项横断面研究中，23名pwRA（疾病活动评分28>2.6，52±13岁，20名女性）和18名HCs（52±10岁，14名女性）在1只脚踝上佩戴ActiGraph wGT3X-BT三轴加速度计（ActiGraph LLC）至少4天。基于加速度计的结果包括向量幅度计数/分钟（VM CPM）、步数和中等至剧烈强度PA（MVPA）的时间量。加速度计数据按天（工作日与周末）和一天中的时间（白天与晚上）分类，以研究PA模式。通过问卷（疲劳严重程度量表和改良疲劳影响量表）评估身体疲劳和认知疲劳。使用多水平广义估计方程模型检查疲劳、RA存在和PA之间的关联，以患者和日间时段为水平。测试了RA存在与疲劳之间的交互作用。在各个白天时段，pwRA的VM CPM、步数和MVPA均低于HC（总体：pwRA为1233.4±509.4 cpm/h，HC为1701.2±492.8；586.9±225.8 vs 723.8±224.1步/h；1.6±1.4 vs 2.7±1.5分钟/h）。多变量分析显示，pwRA的VM CPM较低（β=-330.63；95% CI=-650.45至-10.81），疲劳较高（β=-43.89；95% CI=-135.26至47.48），体重指数较高（β=-27.18；95% CI=-50.73至-3.62）。疲劳或白天时段对PA的影响未因RA存在而改变。pwRA进行的PA少于HC。疲劳对pwRA和HC的PA有相似的负面影响。

items.title: Canakinumab for systemic-onset juvenile idiopathic arthritis/Still's disease-effectiveness and safety data from the BiKeR registry.
items.abstract: In Germany, canakinumab is approved for the treatment of refractory systemic juvenile idiopathic arthritis (sJIA)/Still's disease. This study assesses the experience of sJIA/Still's disease patients treated with canakinumab in clinical practice. Data of 79 sJIA/Still's disease patients extracted from the BiKeR registry included patients' and disease characteristics. Three subgroups with disease durations before canakinumab initiation of ≤3 months, >3 to ≤12 months, and >12 months were compared, and 2 with canakinumab as first- and second- or more-line treatment. Disease duration was ≤3 months before canakinumab initiation for 26 patients, >3 to ≤12 months for 24 patients, and >12 months for 29 patients. Thirty-nine patients received canakinumab as first-line treatment and 40 as second- or more-line treatment. Disease severity as assessed by the systemic Juvenile Arthritis Disease Activity Score-10 (sJADAS10) was highest for patients with a disease duration <3 months before canakinumab initiation. In the total cohort, after 3, 6, 12, 18, and 24 months, 86%, 81%, 81%, 75%, and 87% of patients reached inactive disease, respectively. Numerically, more patients reached the treatment goal of inactive disease when the disease duration was shorter before initiation of canakinumab. Minimal disease activity (sJADAS10 ≤6.0) did not differ among subgroups. Compared with second-line, more patients with first-line treatment reached inactive disease at months 6, 12, and 24 after canakinumab initiation. sJADAS10 at 12 months correlated significantly with disease duration before treatment. Canakinumab treatment led to high improvement rates and achievement of inactive disease state, particularly if they are administered early. Data from clinical practice confirm clinical study data.

items.titleZh: 卡纳基单抗治疗全身型幼年特发性关节炎/斯蒂尔病——来自BiKeR登记处的有效性和安全性数据
items.abstractZh: 在德国，卡纳基单抗被批准用于治疗难治性全身型幼年特发性关节炎（sJIA）/斯蒂尔病。本研究评估了临床实践中接受卡纳基单抗治疗的sJIA/斯蒂尔病患者的经验。从BiKeR登记处提取的79例sJIA/斯蒂尔病患者的数据包括患者和疾病特征。比较了卡纳基单抗启动前病程≤3个月、>3至≤12个月和>12个月的三个亚组，以及卡纳基单抗作为一线和二线或以上治疗的2个亚组。26例患者在卡纳基单抗启动前病程≤3个月，24例>3至≤12个月，29例>12个月。39例患者接受卡纳基单抗作为一线治疗，40例作为二线或以上治疗。通过全身型幼年关节炎疾病活动评分-10（sJADAS10）评估的疾病严重程度在卡纳基单抗启动前病程<3个月的患者中最高。在总队列中，3、6、12、18和24个月后，分别有86%、81%、81%、75%和87%的患者达到非活动性疾病。数值上，卡纳基单抗启动前病程较短的患者达到非活动性疾病治疗目标的人数更多。最小疾病活动度（sJADAS10≤6.0）在各亚组间无差异。与二线治疗相比，一线治疗的患者在卡纳基单抗启动后6、12和24个月达到非活动性疾病的人数更多。12个月时的sJADAS10与治疗前病程显著相关。卡纳基单抗治疗导致高改善率和达到非活动性疾病状态，特别是如果早期给药。临床实践数据证实了临床研究数据。

items.title: Usefulness of the illustrated patient-reported outcome tool 'Okomarigoto Sheet' for symptom expression and communication in patients with rheumatoid arthritis.
items.abstract: This study aimed to evaluate whether the 'Okomarigoto Sheet' (OS), an illustration-based tool for patients with rheumatoid arthritis (RA), correlates with conventional measures and elicits patient symptoms. The OS includes 3 symptom scales: morning stiffness duration, and visual analogue scale (VAS) for joint pain and VAS for fatigue. Five illustrations depicting 5 different situations for each symptom were also scored (0 = none, 1 = present, and 2 = severe, respectively). Patients with RA were recruited from 4 Japanese clinics. Correlations between the OS and conventional RA-related measures were assessed using Spearman's rank correlation. Eighty patients with RA participated in this study. The total score of all 15 illustrations positively correlated with the Disease Activity Score using the Clinical Disease Activity Index and negatively with the physical and mental component scores of the Short-Form-12. Stiffness duration, pain VAS, and fatigue VAS were each positively correlated with the respective total of 5 illustrations. Among patients scoring 0 on stiffness duration, pain VAS, or fatigue VAS, a total of 10 patients showed symptoms in the corresponding illustrations. Patient global assessment (PGA) was correlated with the total score of 5 illustrations for each of the 3 symptoms, whereas evaluator global assessment (EGA) correlated only with those for stiffness and pain, not fatigue. The OS reflected standard measures of disease activity and quality of life. It also has the potential to clarify symptoms that are not captured by conventional measures. Furthermore, the OS suggested that fatigue may be one of the factors contributing to the discrepancy between PGA and EGA.

items.title: Maintained improvement in patient-reported outcomes in early axial spondyloarthritis following certolizumab pegol dose reduction: findings from the randomised period of a phase 3b trial.
items.abstract: In the phase 3b C-OPTIMISE study (ClinicalTrials.gov, NCT02505542), approximately 80% of patients with early active axial spondyloarthritis (axSpA) remained flare-free from week (W)48 to W96 with full-dose and reduced-dose certolizumab pegol (CZP) after gaining sustained remission (Axial Spondyloarthritis Disease Activity Score <1.3 at W32/36, and W48; if <1.3 at W32, <2.1 was required at W36, or vice versa). Patient-reported outcomes (PROs) are presented throughout the maintenance period for patients in sustained remission at W48. After open-label CZP through W48, patients were double-blind randomised 1:1:1 to full-dose CZP (200 mg every 2 weeks [Q2W]), reduced-dose CZP (Q4W), or placebo. Prespecified PROs: Bath Ankylosing Spondylitis Disease Activity Index (BASDAI), Bath Ankylosing Spondylitis Functional Index (BASFI). Post hoc : Patient's Global Assessment of Disease Activity (PtGADA), nocturnal spinal pain (NSP), and Ankylosing Spondylitis Quality of Life (ASQoL). At W48, 43.9% of patients (323/736) achieved sustained remission. At timepoints from W48 through W96, PRO scores were maintained with full-dose and reduced-dose CZP, vs rapid increases (worsening) with placebo. At W96, least squares mean score change from W48 with full-dose and reduced-dose CZP vs placebo ( P < .001) was: BASDAI total 0.56 and 0.78 vs 3.02; BASDAI morning stiffness 0.58 and 0.73 vs 3.56; BASDAI fatigue 0.52 and 0.70 vs 2.12; BASFI 0.32 and 0.46 vs 1.90; PtGADA 0.67 and 0.98 vs 3.65; NSP 0.62 and 0.80 vs 2.60; and ASQoL 0.54 and 0.86 vs 4.28. In patients who achieved remission at W48, reduced-dose and full-dose CZP maintained axSpA in remission without impacting PROs through W96.

items.titleZh: 早期中轴型脊柱关节炎患者接受培塞利珠单抗减量治疗后患者报告结局持续改善：一项3b期试验随机期的结果
items.abstractZh: 在3b期C-OPTIMISE研究（ClinicalTrials.gov，NCT02505542）中，约80%的早期活动性中轴型脊柱关节炎（axSpA）患者在获得持续缓解（第32/36周和第48周中轴型脊柱关节炎疾病活动度评分<1.3；若第32周<1.3，则第36周需<2.1，反之亦然）后，接受全剂量和减量培塞利珠单抗（CZP）治疗，从第48周至第96周维持无复发状态。现报告第48周处于持续缓解的患者在维持期内的患者报告结局（PROs）。在开放标签CZP治疗至第48周后，患者按1:1:1比例双盲随机分配至全剂量CZP（每2周200 mg [Q2W]）、减量CZP（每4周一次）或安慰剂组。预设PROs：巴斯强直性脊柱炎疾病活动指数（BASDAI）、巴斯强直性脊柱炎功能指数（BASFI）。事后分析：患者总体疾病活动评估（PtGADA）、夜间脊柱疼痛（NSP）和强直性脊柱炎生活质量量表（ASQoL）。第48周时，43.9%的患者（323/736）达到持续缓解。从第48周至第96周的各个时间点，全剂量和减量CZP组的PRO评分均得以维持，而安慰剂组则迅速升高（恶化）。第96周时，与安慰剂相比，全剂量和减量CZP组自第48周的最小二乘均值变化（P<.001）为：BASDAI总分0.56和0.78对比3.02；BASDAI晨僵0.58和0.73对比3.56；BASDAI疲劳0.52和0.70对比2.12；BASFI 0.32和0.46对比1.90；PtGADA 0.67和0.98对比3.65；NSP 0.62和0.80对比2.60；ASQoL 0.54和0.86对比4.28。在第48周达到缓解的患者中，减量和全剂量CZP维持了axSpA缓解状态，且至第96周未对PROs产生不良影响。

items.title: Temporal incidence and impact of dementia in rheumatoid arthritis: a cohort study.
items.abstract: The objective of this study is to address conflicting evidence that chronic inflammation may increase the risk of dementia in patients with rheumatoid arthritis (RA). Retrospective population-based study using longitudinally linked administrative health data over a 30-year period for ever hospitalised patients with RA (n = 14,041, age 64 years, 67.2% female) and controls (n = 33,785, age 65 years, 65.6% female). Dementia was defined by the International Classification of Diseases codes for Alzheimer's disease (AD), vascular dementia, and nonspecific dementia subtypes. Dementia incidence rate (IR) and mortality rate (MR) per 1000 person-years and comorbidities are reported. During 9.6 years of follow-up, 1463 (10.4%) of patients with RA and 3701 (11%) of controls were diagnosed with dementia at respective age of 83 vs 84 years ( P = .01). The IR was 12.07 (95% CI: 11.15-12.71) in patients with RA and 11.59 (95% CI: 11.22-11.97) in controls corresponding to an IR ratio of 1.04 (95% CI: 0.98-1.11, P = .21), which did not change significantly over 3 decades. Traditional risk factors for dementia were equal in both groups, but patients with RA with dementia were less likely to be classified as AD (odds ratio = 0.59, 95% CI: 0.48-0.73, P < .001). Hospitalisation rates after dementia diagnosis were higher for patients with RA, and the crude MR (overall 91.8 vs 90.4, P = .64) remained similar before or after 2000 for both groups. There was no difference in temporal incidence and MRs for dementia between patients with RA and matched controls. These data suggest that there is minimal impact of RA on the frequency and outcome of dementia.

items.titleZh: 类风湿关节炎中痴呆的时间发病率和影响：一项队列研究。
items.abstractZh: 本研究的目的是解决关于慢性炎症可能增加类风湿关节炎（RA）患者痴呆风险的相互矛盾的证据。这是一项基于人群的回顾性研究，使用30年间纵向关联的行政健康数据，研究对象包括曾住院的RA患者（n = 14,041，年龄64岁，67.2%为女性）和对照组（n = 33,785，年龄65岁，65.6%为女性）。痴呆通过国际疾病分类代码定义为阿尔茨海默病（AD）、血管性痴呆和非特异性痴呆亚型。报告了每1000人年的痴呆发病率（IR）和死亡率（MR）以及合并症。在9.6年的随访期间，1463名（10.4%）RA患者和3701名（11%）对照组被诊断为痴呆，诊断时年龄分别为83岁和84岁（P = .01）。RA患者的IR为12.07（95% CI: 11.15-12.71），对照组为11.59（95% CI: 11.22-11.97），对应的IR比值为1.04（95% CI: 0.98-1.11, P = .21），这在30年间没有显著变化。两组的痴呆传统危险因素相同，但患有痴呆的RA患者被分类为AD的可能性较低（比值比 = 0.59, 95% CI: 0.48-0.73, P < .001）。痴呆诊断后，RA患者的住院率更高，粗MR（总体91.8 vs 90.4, P = .64）在2000年前后两组保持相似。RA患者与匹配对照组之间痴呆的时间发病率和MR没有差异。这些数据表明，RA对痴呆的频率和结果影响很小。

items.title: Novel insights into the imaging of axial spondyloarthritis.
items.abstract: Axial spondyloarthritis (axSpA) is a chronic immune-mediated disease primarily affecting the sacroiliac joints and spine. Imaging plays a central role in the diagnosis, classification, and disease monitoring of axSpA. In this manuscript, recent developments in imaging that enhance both early detection and the understanding of disease progression are presented and discussed. Key topics include the role of conventional radiographs and their accuracy in the identification of axSpA-related imaging findings, the role of magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) scans or other advanced imaging techniques in identifying inflammatory and structural lesions, and the significance of fat lesions as a marker of postinflammatory changes with the potential to predict new bone formation. Emerging applications of quantitative imaging and artificial intelligence in image analysis are also highlighted. Recent advances in imaging have significantly transformed the diagnostic landscape of axSpA. These insights support the integration of imaging as a biomarker for personalised treatment strategies.

items.titleZh: 中轴型脊柱关节炎影像学的新见解
items.abstractZh: 中轴型脊柱关节炎（axSpA）是一种慢性免疫介导性疾病，主要影响骶髂关节和脊柱。影像学在axSpA的诊断、分类和疾病监测中起着核心作用。本文介绍并讨论了影像学在增强早期检测和理解疾病进展方面的最新进展。关键主题包括传统X线片在识别axSpA相关影像学表现中的作用及其准确性，磁共振成像（MRI）或其他先进影像技术在识别炎症性和结构性病变中的作用，以及脂肪病变作为炎症后改变标志物并可能预测新骨形成的意义。还强调了定量影像学和人工智能在图像分析中的新兴应用。影像学的最新进展已显著改变了axSpA的诊断格局。这些见解支持将影像学作为个性化治疗策略的生物标志物进行整合。

items.title: Rethinking imaging in axial spondyloarthritis: toward diagnostic maturity.
items.abstract: Imaging, particularly magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) scans of the sacroiliac joints, has become central in the evaluation of axial spondyloarthritis (axSpA), partly due to the absence of reliable biomarkers and variable human leukocyte antigen B27 (HLA-B27) prevalence. However, its increasing use as a standalone diagnostic tool represents a conceptual shift that risks undermining clinical reasoning. This viewpoint critically examined the specificity and limitations of imaging findings and highlighted that lesions such as bone marrow oedema and structural changes may also occur in non-SpA populations, including healthy individuals and those with mechanical back pain. Misinterpretation, rather than intrinsic imaging limitations, is a major driver of diagnostic error. In this viewpoint it is argued that imaging should serve a supportive and prognostic role, integrated within a broader clinical framework that includes patient history, clinical features, and laboratory data. Overreliance on imaging contributes to diagnostic inflation, particularly in non-adiographic and atypical populations, with implications for patient care and healthcare systems. Emerging tools such as artificial intelligence may amplify these challenges if not carefully validated. Recentring clinical reasoning, promoting multidisciplinary collaboration, and ensuring imaging is requested and interpreted within an appropriate clinical context are essential steps forward. Ultimately, imaging should inform but not replace clinical judgement in the diagnosis of axSpA.

items.titleZh: 重新思考中轴型脊柱关节炎的影像学：迈向诊断成熟
items.abstractZh: 影像学，特别是骶髂关节的磁共振成像（MRI）扫描，已成为评估中轴型脊柱关节炎（axSpA）的核心手段，部分原因是缺乏可靠的生物标志物以及人类白细胞抗原B27（HLA-B27）阳性率的差异。然而，其作为独立诊断工具的日益广泛使用代表了一种概念性转变，可能削弱临床推理。本观点文章批判性地审视了影像学发现的特异性和局限性，并强调骨髓水肿和结构改变等病变也可能出现在非SpA人群中，包括健康个体和机械性腰痛患者。误读而非影像学固有的局限性，是诊断错误的主要驱动因素。本文认为，影像学应发挥支持和预后作用，并整合到包括病史、临床特征和实验室数据在内的更广泛的临床框架中。过度依赖影像学导致诊断膨胀，尤其是在非放射学和非典型人群中，对患者护理和医疗系统产生影响。人工智能等新兴工具若未经仔细验证，可能加剧这些挑战。重新聚焦临床推理、促进多学科协作，并确保在适当的临床背景下进行影像学检查和解读，是前进的关键步骤。最终，在axSpA的诊断中，影像学应提供信息，但不应取代临床判断。

items.title: Does effective therapy of psoriasis prevent the development of psoriatic arthritis?
items.abstract: Psoriasis frequently precedes psoriatic arthritis (PsA), delineating a tractable window for disease interception. This narrative review integrates mechanistic, imaging, and clinical evidence, together with expert interpretation, to examine whether effective treatment of psoriasis may modify the risk of PsA development. Converging immunopathogenic insights link skin and joint inflammation through interleukin (IL)-23/IL-17-driven pathways, enthesis-synovium crosstalk, and tissue-resident memory T-cell biology. Clinically, progression from psoriasis with arthralgia to PsA occurs in ∼20% of patients within 3 years, typically manifesting with peripheral, synovitis-predominant presentations. Imaging refines short-term risk stratification, with structural entheseal lesions, particularly erosions and new bone formation, representing the most consistent markers of transition. Observational data suggest that biologic therapies used for psoriasis may reduce PsA evolution, with the most consistent evidence for IL-23 pathway blockade. Metabolic factors, notably obesity and weight loss, further modify disease risk, underscoring the role of systemic inflammation and metabolic-immune crosstalk. Together, these findings support the biological plausibility of PsA prevention and justify ongoing interception trials in high-risk psoriasis populations defined by arthralgia and subclinical musculoskeletal inflammation. Robust longitudinal studies integrating biological, imaging, and pragmatic outcomes will be essential to establish causality and define scalable strategies to alter the natural history of psoriatic disease.

items.title: Zhuangdu Quhan Mixture Alleviates Ankylosing Spondylitis in Mice by Inhibiting the Interleukin-17 Signaling.
items.abstract: This study aimed to elucidate the therapeutic effect and mechanism of Zhuangdu Quhan Mixture (ZDQHM) in ankylosing spondylitis (AS). An AS mouse model was established in mice using β-glucan. Therapeutic efficacy was assessed through arthritis scores, histopathology, serum cytokine measurement by ELISA, and bone metabolism-related protein analysis via Western blot. Active compounds were identified by UHPLC-MS, with targets predicted using network pharmacology and validated by molecular docking and molecular dynamics simulations. ZDQHM significantly ameliorated spinal inflammation and histopathological damage, reduced serum IL-6 and TNF-α levels, and modulated bone metabolism proteins. Network pharmacology identified 45 intersecting targets between ZDQHM compounds and AS, predominantly enriched in IL-17, Toll-like receptor, and NOD-like receptor pathways. Molecular docking and dynamics demonstrated binding of key compounds to IL-17A. In vivo validation revealed that ZDQHM suppressed IL-17A, Act1, and IL-17RA expression, and recombinant IL-17A partially reversed its therapeutic effects. ZDQHM alleviates inflammation and abnormal bone metabolism in AS mice, potentially through inhibition of the IL-17 signaling pathway. Beyond confirming the established role of IL-17 in AS, this study provides an integrated pharmacological framework explaining how ZDQHM exerts its effects via regulation of the IL-17A/IL-17RA/Act1 axis, offering mechanistic insights and experimental support for TCM in AS therapy.

items.titleZh: 壮督祛寒合剂通过抑制白细胞介素-17信号通路减轻小鼠强直性脊柱炎
items.abstractZh: 本研究旨在阐明壮督祛寒合剂（ZDQHM）对强直性脊柱炎（AS）的治疗作用及其机制。使用β-葡聚糖在小鼠中建立AS模型。通过关节炎评分、组织病理学、ELISA检测血清细胞因子以及Western blot分析骨代谢相关蛋白来评估治疗效果。通过UHPLC-MS鉴定活性化合物，使用网络药理学预测靶点，并通过分子对接和分子动力学模拟进行验证。ZDQHM显著改善脊柱炎症和组织病理损伤，降低血清IL-6和TNF-α水平，并调节骨代谢蛋白。网络药理学鉴定出ZDQHM化合物与AS之间的45个交集靶点，主要富集于IL-17、Toll样受体和NOD-样受体通路。分子对接和动力学表明关键化合物与IL-17A结合。体内验证显示，ZDQHM抑制IL-17A、Act1和IL-17RA的表达，而重组IL-17A部分逆转了其治疗效果。ZDQHM减轻AS小鼠的炎症和异常骨代谢，可能通过抑制IL-17信号通路实现。除了确认IL-17在AS中的既定作用外，本研究还提供了一个整合的药理学框架，解释了ZDQHM如何通过调节IL-17A/IL-17RA/Act1轴发挥其作用，为TCM治疗AS提供了机制见解和实验支持。

items.title: Evolution of self-reactive B cells: lessons from a lupus model.
items.abstract: Systemic lupus erythematosus develops when autoreactive B cells escape tolerance and enter differentiation pathways that sustain pathogenic autoantibody responses. A defining feature of lupus is the evolving autoantibody repertoire, in which initially focused autoreactivity broadens over time through recruitment of additional self-reactive B cell clones as well as continued mutation and selection of B cells engaged in the response. Here, we review insights from the 564Igi lupus model, in which a defined autoreactive B cell clone creates an autoimmune environment that permits a previously tolerant polyclonal wild-type (WT) B cell repertoire to enter the response. Studies using mixed bone marrow chimera and adoptive transfer approaches show that WT-derived B cells can be recruited into established autoreactive niches, participate in germinal center and extrafollicular pathways, and contribute to epitope-spread autoantibody responses. We discuss how studies in the present model have reframed epitope spreading as a dynamic process of self-reactive B cell evolution, in which otherwise restrained B cells are incorporated into an ongoing autoimmune response and shaped by the niches that support their activation, differentiation, persistence, and diversification.

items.title: Preoperative predictors of patient-reported outcomes after joint-preserving forefoot surgery for rheumatoid arthritis : a case series.
items.abstract: Forefoot deformities are common in patients with rheumatoid arthritis (RA) and often impair quality of life. Patient-reported outcome measures (PROMs), including the Self-Administered Foot Evaluation Questionnaire (SAFE-Q), are increasingly used to assess surgical outcomes; however, the preoperative conditions needed to achieve favourable postoperative PROMs remain unclear. This study aimed to identify factors associated with postoperative SAFE-Q scores (mean score across five sub-scales, maximum 100) and determined preoperative cutoff values predictive of achieving predefined postoperative SAFE-Q thresholds (≥ 70 or ≥ 90). In this multicentre, retrospective case series, 101 feet in 80 patients (including 21 bilateral cases) with RA who underwent forefoot surgery between July 2015 and July 2023 were analyzed (mean age at surgery 65.8 years (SD 10.7); 79 female patients). Inclusion criteria were symptomatic forefoot deformities with available SAFE-Q data pre-surgery and at ≥ one year post-surgery. Procedures included modified scarf osteotomy and offset shortening osteotomies for the metatarsals. SAFE-Q scores, Japanese Society for Surgery of the Foot scores, radiological parameters, and disease activity were evaluated pre- and postoperatively. Multiple regression identified preoperative factors associated with postoperative SAFE-Q scores, and significant variables were further assessed using receiver operating characteristic (ROC) analyses to determine preoperative cutoff values for postoperative SAFE-Q thresholds (≥ 70 and ≥ 90). Postoperatively, the median SAFE-Q score was 84.8 (IQR 73.0 to 92.3), a significant improvement over the preoperative median score of 48.9 (IQR 34.9 to 67.5; p < 0.001). Multivariable analysis showed that older age and lower preoperative SAFE-Q scores were associated with lower postoperative SAFE-Q scores (β -0.286 (95% CI -0.486 to -0.086) and 0.505 (95% CI 0.319 to 0.691), respectively). ROC analysis identified cutoffs of 54.0 for preoperative SAFE-Q (area under the curve (AUC) 0.644) and 70 years for age (AUC 0.722) when predicting a postoperative score ≥ 90. Higher preoperative SAFE-Q scores and younger age at surgery were linked to improved postoperative outcomes. Although their predictive accuracy is limited, these thresholds may help estimate postoperative function and support preoperative counselling and shared decision-making.

items.titleZh: 类风湿关节炎保关节前足手术后患者报告结局的术前预测因素：一项病例系列研究
items.abstractZh: 前足畸形在类风湿关节炎（RA）患者中常见，常损害生活质量。患者报告结局指标（PROMs），包括自我管理足部评估问卷（SAFE-Q），越来越多地用于评估手术结局；然而，实现良好术后PROMs所需的术前条件仍不清楚。本研究旨在确定与术后SAFE-Q评分（五个子量表平均分，最高100分）相关的因素，并确定预测达到预设术后SAFE-Q阈值（≥70或≥90）的术前临界值。在这项多中心、回顾性病例系列研究中，分析了2015年7月至2023年7月期间接受前足手术的80例RA患者（包括21例双侧病例）的101只足（手术时平均年龄65.8岁（SD 10.7）；79例女性患者）。纳入标准为有症状的前足畸形，且术前和术后至少一年有可用的SAFE-Q数据。手术方式包括改良scarf截骨术和跖骨偏移短缩截骨术。术前和术后评估了SAFE-Q评分、日本足外科学会评分、影像学参数和疾病活动度。多元回归确定了与术后SAFE-Q评分相关的术前因素，并进一步使用受试者工作特征（ROC）分析评估显著变量，以确定术后SAFE-Q阈值（≥70和≥90）的术前临界值。术后，SAFE-Q评分中位数为84.8（IQR 73.0至92.3），较术前中位数48.9（IQR 34.9至67.5；p < 0.001）显著改善。多变量分析显示，年龄较大和术前SAFE-Q评分较低与术后SAFE-Q评分较低相关（β -0.286（95% CI -0.486至-0.086）和0.505（95% CI 0.319至0.691））。ROC分析确定，预测术后评分≥90时，术前SAFE-Q的临界值为54.0（曲线下面积（AUC）0.644），年龄的临界值为70岁（AUC 0.722）。较高的术前SAFE-Q评分和较年轻的手术年龄与改善的术后结局相关。尽管其预测准确性有限，但这些阈值可能有助于估计术后功能，并支持术前咨询和共同决策。

items.title: PD-1 hi CXCR5 - CD4 + T Peripheral Helper Cells Were Enriched and Potentially Predicted Clinical Response to Etanercept Therapy in Rheumatoid Arthritis.
items.abstract: Rheumatoid arthritis (RA) remains a challenging autoimmune disease with variable treatment responses to tumor necrosis factor-α (TNF-α) inhibitors. This study investigates the clinical significance of PD-1 hi CXCR5 - CD4 + T peripheral helper (Tph) cells in RA and their potential utility as biomarkers for predicting etanercept (ETN) therapy response. We enrolled 58 RA patients, 12 age- and sex-matched osteoarthritis patients, and 15 healthy controls, with Tph cells quantified by flow cytometry. Among 25 RA patients with inadequate response to conventional synthetic disease-modifying antirheumatic drugs receiving ETN therapy, treatment outcomes were stratified by ACR20 response criteria. Tph cell frequency was significantly elevated in RA patients and correlated positively with multiple disease activity indicators. At baseline, ETN nonresponders exhibited higher Tph proportions than responders (13.23 ± 2.60% vs. 10.82 ± 3.08%, p = 0.0467). Following ETN treatment, responders demonstrated significant Tph reduction (10.82% decreased to 7.97%, p = 0.0105), paralleling serum IL‑21 dynamics. In an exploratory analysis, baseline Tph levels showed an association with ETN response. These findings suggest that circulating Tph cells may serve as a candidate biomarker for RA disease activity and therapeutic response monitoring, warranting further validation in larger prospective cohorts.

items.titleZh: PD-1高表达CXCR5阴性CD4阳性T外周辅助细胞在类风湿关节炎中富集，并可能预测依那西普治疗的临床应答
items.abstractZh: 类风湿关节炎（RA）仍然是一种具有挑战性的自身免疫性疾病，其对肿瘤坏死因子-α（TNF-α）抑制剂的治疗反应各异。本研究探讨了RA中PD-1高表达CXCR5阴性CD4阳性T外周辅助（Tph）细胞的临床意义，及其作为预测依那西普（ETN）治疗应答的生物标志物的潜在用途。我们纳入了58例RA患者、12例年龄和性别匹配的骨关节炎患者以及15例健康对照，通过流式细胞术定量Tph细胞。在25例对传统合成改善病情抗风湿药反应不佳并接受ETN治疗的RA患者中，根据ACR20应答标准对治疗结果进行分层。RA患者中Tph细胞频率显著升高，并与多项疾病活动指标呈正相关。基线时，ETN无应答者的Tph比例高于应答者（13.23% ± 2.60% vs. 10.82% ± 3.08%，p = 0.0467）。ETN治疗后，应答者表现出显著的Tph减少（10.82%降至7.97%，p = 0.0105），与血清IL-21动态变化平行。在探索性分析中，基线Tph水平与ETN应答相关。这些发现提示，循环Tph细胞可能作为RA疾病活动和治疗反应监测的候选生物标志物，值得在更大的前瞻性队列中进一步验证。

items.title: Real-World Effectiveness and Safety of Dotinurad in Chinese Patients with Gout: A Comparative Analysis.
items.abstract: Dotinurad, a novel selective uric acid (UA) reabsorption inhibitor, exerts its hypouricemic effect through the selective inhibition of urate transporter 1 (URAT1). The present study aimed to investigate the short-term effectiveness and safety of dotinurad in the treatment of Chinese patients with gout, while also conducting a comparative analysis with febuxostat. This retrospective study enrolled 70 consecutive eligible inpatients and outpatients with gout from the Department of Rheumatology and Immunology, The Affiliated Guangdong Second Provincial General Hospital of Jinan University, were screened during the period from 1 January 2025 to 30 December 2025. Treatment was prescribed at the discretion of the treating clinician: 35 patients receiving dotinurad and 35 receiving febuxostat. The primary analyses focused on serum uric acid (UA) target attainment (≤ 360 μmol/L or ≤ 300 μmol/L) for patients with dotinurad or febuxostat) and short-term urate-lowering effectiveness after 4 weeks of treatment. Short-term changes in hepatic and renal function parameters were also evaluated. After one month of treatment, the attainment rates for UA ≤ 360 μmol/L in the dotinurad group and the febuxostat group were 60.0% and 45.7%, respectively. The attainment rates for UA ≤ 300 μmol/L were 45.7% and 14.3%, respectively. While baseline UA levels did not differ significantly between the two groups (P = 0.227), a significant difference was observed after 4 weeks of treatment (The serum UA levels at week-4 after treatment in the dotinurad group and febuxostat group were 294.47 ± 19.31 and 380.85 ± 21.43, respectively; P = 0.003). After one month of treatment, significant intergroup differences were observed in the changes from baseline of UA and serum creatinine (SCR) (P = 0.003 and P = 0.029, respectively), whereas no statistically significant intergroup differences were found in the changes from baseline of serum alanine aminotransferase (ALT) and aspartate aminotransferase (AST) (P = 0.761 and P = 0.551, respectively). It was found that 2 mg/day of Dotinurad was superior to 40 mg/day of febuxostat in achieving serum UA levels ≤ 360 μmol/L or ≤ 300 μmol/L after 4 weeks in Chinese patients with gout and exerted superior short-term urate-lowering effectiveness to febuxostat. Additionally, dotinurad is not associated with a risk of hepatic or renal injury in the short term, whereas febuxostat may increase SCR levels over the short course. The conclusions are only applicable to the clinical medication setting where febuxostat is initiated at a dose of 40 mg in Chinese patients with gout.

items.titleZh: 多替诺雷在中国痛风患者中的真实世界有效性与安全性：一项比较分析
items.abstractZh: 多替诺雷是一种新型选择性尿酸（UA）重吸收抑制剂，通过选择性抑制尿酸盐转运蛋白1（URAT1）发挥其降尿酸作用。本研究旨在探讨多替诺雷治疗中国痛风患者的短期有效性和安全性，并与非布司他进行比较分析。这项回顾性研究纳入了暨南大学附属广东省第二人民医院风湿免疫科2025年1月1日至2025年12月30日期间连续筛选的70例符合条件的住院和门诊痛风患者。治疗方案由主治医师酌情决定：35例患者接受多替诺雷，35例接受非布司他。主要分析集中于血清尿酸（UA）达标率（≤360 μmol/L或≤300 μmol/L）以及治疗4周后的短期降尿酸效果。同时评估了肝肾功能参数的短期变化。治疗1个月后，多替诺雷组和非布司他组UA≤360 μmol/L的达标率分别为60.0%和45.7%。UA≤300 μmol/L的达标率分别为45.7%和14.3%。虽然两组基线UA水平无显著差异（P=0.227），但治疗4周后观察到显著差异（多替诺雷组和非布司他组治疗第4周血清UA水平分别为294.47±19.31和380.85±21.43；P=0.003）。治疗1个月后，UA和血清肌酐（SCR）较基线的变化存在显著的组间差异（分别为P=0.003和P=0.029），而血清丙氨酸氨基转移酶（ALT）和天冬氨酸氨基转移酶（AST）较基线的变化无统计学显著组间差异（分别为P=0.761和P=0.551）。研究发现，在中国痛风患者中，多替诺雷2 mg/天在治疗4周后达到血清UA≤360 μmol/L或≤300 μmol/L方面优于非布司他40 mg/天，且短期降尿酸效果优于非布司他。此外，多替诺雷短期内与肝或肾损伤风险无关，而非布司他可能在短期疗程中增加SCR水平。这些结论仅适用于中国痛风患者以40 mg剂量起始非布司他的临床用药情境。

items.title: Longitudinal Instability of Minimal Disease Activity Domains in Psoriatic Arthritis with Fluctuating Response: A Trajectory Analysis of a Real-World Cohort.
items.abstract: Minimal disease activity (MDA) is a composite tool used to measure disease state in psoriatic arthritis (PsA), but its longitudinal stability across individual domains remains insufficiently understood. We aimed to investigate domain-specific instability of MDA components over time in patients with fluctuating disease states. This post hoc analysis of a real-world longitudinal cohort included patients with PsA treated with biologic or targeted synthetic disease-modifying anti-rheumatic drugs (bDMARDs or tsDMARDs) who exhibited fluctuating trajectories over 24 months. MDA was assessed at 6-month intervals across seven domains. For each domain, an instability score (IS) was calculated as the number of transitions across the MDA cutoff between consecutive visits. Domains were also grouped into objective, tenderness-based, and subjective categories. Longitudinal instability patterns were analyzed and compared across domains. Among 289 patients in the parent cohort, 107 (37.0%) exhibited fluctuating MDA trajectories and were included in the analysis. Objective domains showed the lowest instability over time, whereas tenderness-based and subjective domains demonstrated higher and more variable instability patterns. Domain-level analyses revealed marked heterogeneity across individual MDA components. In patients with PsA and fluctuating disease states, MDA instability is predominantly associated with subjective and tenderness-based domains, whereas objective inflammatory measures remain relatively stable. Domain-level analysis provides additional insight beyond composite MDA and may improve interpretation of longitudinal disease dynamics.

items.titleZh: 银屑病关节炎波动性反应中最小疾病活动度各领域的纵向不稳定性：一项真实世界队列的轨迹分析
items.abstractZh: 最小疾病活动度（MDA）是用于衡量银屑病关节炎（PsA）疾病状态的复合工具，但其各领域在纵向上的稳定性仍了解不足。我们旨在调查疾病状态波动的患者中MDA各组成部分随时间的领域特异性不稳定性。这项对真实世界纵向队列的事后分析纳入了接受生物制剂或靶向合成改善病情抗风湿药（bDMARDs或tsDMARDs）治疗且在24个月内表现出波动轨迹的PsA患者。MDA每6个月评估一次，涵盖七个领域。对于每个领域，计算不稳定性评分（IS），即连续就诊之间跨越MDA临界值的次数。领域还分为客观性、压痛性和主观性类别。分析并比较了各领域的纵向不稳定性模式。在亲代队列的289名患者中，107名（37.0%）表现出波动的MDA轨迹并被纳入分析。客观性领域随时间显示出最低的不稳定性，而压痛性和主观性领域则表现出更高且更多变的不稳定性模式。领域水平分析揭示了各MDA组成部分之间的显著异质性。在疾病状态波动的PsA患者中，MDA不稳定性主要与主观性和压痛性领域相关，而客观炎症指标保持相对稳定。领域水平分析提供了超越复合MDA的额外见解，并可能改善对纵向疾病动态的解释。

items.title: From psoriatic plaque to synovium: decoding the skin-joint axis in psoriatic arthritis.
items.abstract: Psoriatic arthritis (PsA) develops in up to 30% of individuals with psoriasis, but the mechanisms that drive progression from skin-limited disease to musculoskeletal disease remain incompletely understood. Emerging evidence supports a functional skin-joint axis in which psoriatic plaques function not only as sites of local inflammation but also as sources of immune cells capable of shaping musculoskeletal pathology. Myeloid progenitors that reside in the inflamed skin can migrate to synovial compartments; however, cell trafficking alone is insufficient to induce arthritis, as the fate of these cells is dictated by the stromal microenvironment of the musculoskeletal niche. Data from single-cell RNA sequencing, imaging mass cytometry and mitochondrial DNA lineage tracing now provide direct evidence that skin-derived myeloid precursors populate synovial tissue in people with early PsA. In parallel, T cell receptor analyses indicate that clonally related T cells are shared between psoriatic skin and inflamed joints, indicating that skin-derived T cells migrate between tissues. Together, these findings fuel a model in which PsA emerges through the convergence of high-risk skin lesions, a systemic milieu permissive to immune cell trafficking and a receptive joint stromal niche, with implications for biomarker discovery, risk stratification and disease interception.

items.titleZh: 从银屑病斑块到滑膜：解码银屑病关节炎的皮肤-关节轴。
items.abstractZh: 银屑病关节炎（PsA）在高达30%的银屑病患者中发生，但驱动从皮肤局限性疾病进展为肌肉骨骼疾病的机制仍不完全清楚。新出现的证据支持一个功能性皮肤-关节轴，其中银屑病斑块不仅作为局部炎症的部位，而且作为能够塑造肌肉骨骼病理的免疫细胞的来源。驻留在发炎皮肤中的髓系祖细胞可以迁移到滑膜腔室；然而，仅细胞运输不足以诱导关节炎，因为这些细胞的命运由肌肉骨骼微环境的基质微环境决定。来自单细胞RNA测序、成像质谱流式细胞术和线粒体DNA谱系追踪的数据现在提供了直接证据，表明皮肤来源的髓系前体在早期PsA患者中填充滑膜组织。同时，T细胞受体分析表明，克隆相关的T细胞在银屑病皮肤和发炎关节之间共享，表明皮肤来源的T细胞在组织之间迁移。总之，这些发现支持一个模型，其中PsA通过高风险皮肤病变、允许免疫细胞运输的全身环境和易感的关节基质微环境的汇聚而出现，这对生物标志物发现、风险分层和疾病拦截具有意义。

items.title: Biological therapy in Takayasu arteritis. Results from the REVAS registry.
items.abstract: Biological therapy in patients with Takayasu arteritis is frequently used, but the factors associated with its use have not been determined. The present study aims to describe and identify predictors of the need for biological therapy in this vasculitis. We conducted a retrospective, multicentre, descriptive study including all patients with Takayasu arteritis enrolled in the REVAS registry from Spain. We performed a descriptive and a multivariate logistic regression analysis to identify variables associated with the need of biological therapy requirement. The study included 77 patients, 65 (84.4 %) women, with a median follow up of 9.9 (interquartile range 3.5-21.5) years. Sixty-three (81.8 %) participants received glucocorticoids and 45 (58.4 %) needed immunosuppressive therapy. Twenty-three patients had received biological therapy, 20 of whom were diagnosed after 2006. Biological therapy included infliximab (n = 3), adalimumab (n = 9) and tocilizumab (n = 18). Patients requiring biological therapy had a higher proportion of systemic symptoms (fever and/or constitutional syndrome) at baseline (70.0 %vs. 28.6 %, p = 0.005), received glucocorticoids more frequently (100.0 %vs. 78.6 %, p = 0.03) and required a greater number of immunosuppressants (2 (1-2) vs. 1 (0-1), p = 0.03) during follow-up. On multivariate logistic regression, the presence of systemic symptoms was associated with the need for biological therapy requirement (odds radio: 3.9 (1.02-14.8), p = 0.047). Conclusion: to our knowledge, this is the first study that evaluates variables associated with the need for biological therapy requirement in Takayasu arteritis. The presence of systemic symptoms at presentation was independently associated with the need for biological therapy, highlighting the importance of a thorough clinical evaluation.

items.titleZh: 大动脉炎的生物治疗：来自REVAS登记研究的结果
items.abstractZh: 大动脉炎患者的生物治疗使用频繁，但与其使用相关的因素尚未确定。本研究旨在描述并识别此类血管炎中需要生物治疗的预测因素。我们进行了一项回顾性、多中心、描述性研究，纳入来自西班牙REVAS登记的所有大动脉炎患者。我们进行了描述性分析和多变量逻辑回归分析，以识别与需要生物治疗相关的变量。研究纳入77例患者，其中65例（84.4%）为女性，中位随访时间为9.9年（四分位距3.5-21.5）。63例（81.8%）参与者接受了糖皮质激素治疗，45例（58.4%）需要免疫抑制治疗。23例患者接受了生物治疗，其中20例在2006年后确诊。生物治疗包括英夫利西单抗（n=3）、阿达木单抗（n=9）和托珠单抗（n=18）。需要生物治疗的患者在基线时全身症状（发热和/或全身性综合征）的比例更高（70.0%对28.6%，p=0.005），更频繁地接受糖皮质激素治疗（100.0%对78.6%，p=0.03），并且在随访期间需要更多的免疫抑制剂（2（1-2）对1（0-1），p=0.03）。在多变量逻辑回归中，全身症状的存在与需要生物治疗相关（比值比：3.9（1.02-14.8），p=0.047）。结论：据我们所知，这是第一项评估大动脉炎中需要生物治疗相关变量的研究。就诊时全身症状的存在与需要生物治疗独立相关，强调了全面临床评估的重要性。

items.title: Role of repeat kidney biopsy after 6 months of treatment in proliferative lupus nephritis.
items.abstract: To characterise histological response following induction therapy in a real-world cohort of patients with proliferative lupus nephritis (LN) undergoing per-protocol repeat kidney biopsy; to assess the concordance between clinical and histological response and to identify baseline factors associated with changes in activity and chronicity indices. We conducted a retrospective observational study including 20 adult patients with systemic lupus erythematosus and biopsy-proven proliferative LN who underwent a protocolised repeat kidney biopsy at 6 months (±3 months) after induction therapy. Clinical, laboratory and histopathological data were collected at both biopsy time points. Associations between baseline parameters and histological outcomes were explored. After a median of 7.5 months, proteinuria significantly decreased while estimated glomerular filtration rate and complement levels significantly improved. The histological activity index (AI) decreased significantly, with improvement observed in 90% of patients. Chronicity index (CI) increased in 50% of patients, without reaching statistical significance. At 6 months, 55% of patients achieved primary efficacy renal response, whereas 45% achieved histological response. Notably, discordance between clinical and histological responses was frequent: 45% of clinical responders exhibited persistent histological activity and 33% of histological responders failed to meet clinical response criteria. Lower baseline proteinuria and better baseline renal function were observed among patients with AI improvement. Likewise, patients with an increase in CI had a lower baseline CI and tended to have a better baseline renal function. Histological outcomes did not differ according to the type of immunosuppressive therapy used during induction. In this real-world cohort of proliferative LN, substantial discordance between clinical and histological response was observed following induction therapy. While histological activity improved in most patients, chronic damage progressed in half of the cohort despite favourable clinical evolution. These findings should be interpreted as exploratory and hypothesis-generating rather than as definitive associations and highlight the need for prospective studies to define its role in personalised LN management.

items.titleZh: 增殖性狼疮性肾炎治疗6个月后重复肾活检的作用
items.abstractZh: 旨在描述真实世界队列中增殖性狼疮性肾炎（LN）患者接受诱导治疗后按方案进行重复肾活检的组织学反应；评估临床反应与组织学反应之间的一致性，并确定与活动性和慢性指数变化相关的基线因素。我们进行了一项回顾性观察性研究，纳入20例经活检证实为增殖性LN的系统性红斑狼疮成年患者，这些患者在诱导治疗后6个月（±3个月）接受了方案化的重复肾活检。在两个活检时间点收集临床、实验室和组织病理学数据。探讨了基线参数与组织学结局之间的关联。中位随访7.5个月后，蛋白尿显著降低，而估算肾小球滤过率和补体水平显著改善。组织学活动指数（AI）显著下降，90%的患者观察到改善。慢性指数（CI）在50%的患者中升高，但未达到统计学显著性。在6个月时，55%的患者达到主要疗效肾脏反应，而45%达到组织学反应。值得注意的是，临床反应与组织学反应之间的不一致很常见：45%的临床反应者表现出持续的组织学活动，33%的组织学反应者未达到临床反应标准。在AI改善的患者中观察到较低的基线蛋白尿和较好的基线肾功能。同样，CI升高的患者基线CI较低，且倾向于具有较好的基线肾功能。组织学结局不因诱导期间使用的免疫抑制治疗类型而异。在这个真实世界的增殖性LN队列中，诱导治疗后观察到临床反应与组织学反应之间存在显著不一致。尽管大多数患者的组织学活动有所改善，但尽管临床演变有利，一半队列的慢性损伤仍在进展。这些发现应被视为探索性和假设生成性的，而非确定性关联，并强调需要前瞻性研究来确定其在LN个体化管理中的作用。

items.title: Plasma lipid alterations in thrombosis and antiphospholipid syndrome - a differentiating lipid plasma composite score.
items.abstract: Antiphospholipid syndrome (APS) is an autoimmune thrombophilia diagnosed by established clinical and serological criteria, distinguishing it from other causes of venous thromboembolism (VTE). This study investigated whether VTE is associated with plasma lipidome changes and whether an APS-specific lipid signature can be identified. We performed quantitative mass spectrometry-based lipidomics on plasma from healthy controls (n = 16), VTE patients without APS (n = 16) and triple-positive APS patients (n = 17), profiling 224 lipid species across all major classes. Ceramide species (Cer 18:1;O2/16:0, /18:0, /20:0 and /26:0) and the Cer 18:0/Cer 24:0 ratio were elevated in both VTE groups relative to healthy controls, consistent with a shared thrombotic state. To identify APS-specific changes, LASSO logistic regression defined a minimal discriminating lipid panel. PE 40:5 (elevated 1.69-fold in APS), SM 43:2;O2 and PC O-34:2 (both reduced by 21-24%) were combined into a parameter-free composite score that discriminated APS from VTE without APS with an AUC of 0.857. PE 40:5 has previously been associated with cardiovascular inflammatory activation, whilst reduction of PC O-34:2 may reflect increased conversion to platelet-activating factor and/or plasmalogen consumption under the pro-inflammatory conditions of APS. The co-occurrence of elevated ceramides and decreased SM 43:2;O2 in APS raises the hypothesis of enhanced acid sphingomyelinase activity driving sphingomyelin-to-ceramide conversion. In conclusion, despite the limited sample size, plasma lipidomics identifies a three-lipid composite score that discriminates APS from VTE without APS. Prospective validation in larger cohorts is warranted to assess its utility as a complement to serological APS diagnostics.
